Marta: Heads-up: rk-lite-ptq shows consistent NDCG win on head anchor (+2.6%) but MRR drop on long-query slice (-3.9%). Canary CTR down ~1.6% after we enabled aggressive topk pruning. Suspect interaction between topk prune + int8 kernel for long sequences.
Ibrahim: Can you paste the eval command and topk settings?
Marta: ```./eval_rerank --model rk-lite-ptq --anchors head_anchor,long_queries_live --candidates 150 --seed 11 --metrics ndcg,mrr,top1_swap --prune.topk=32``` Prod canary used prune.topk=16 and kvpack-int8 kernel for seqlen>256.
Zoey: Two likely culprits: (1) smaller topk prunes away the true winner more often when int8 compresses logits, (2) kvpack-int8 kernel reduces precision for long kv accumulations.
Rafael: I ran a quick ablation: keep topk=32 but force kvpack-int8 -> long-query MRR -3.1%. Keep kvpack-fp16 but topk=16 -> MRR -1.5%. So both hurt, but combined is worst.
Marta: Logged swap rates: top1_swap_long: baseline->int8+prune = 0.052 -> 0.138. Interesting
Ibrahim: Action items: 1) run hybrid (keep final MLP fp16) with prune=16, 2) run int8 kernel but increase prune.topk to 64 to see sensitivity curve.
Zoey: I'll spin jobs: 6942001245 (hybrid+prune16) and 6942001250 (int8+prune64).
DeployBot: Canary 2026-03-24T18:02:12Z deployed rk-lite-ptq to canary-7 (20%). Monitor CTR and topk swap.
Rafael: Also check candidate diversity upstream; smaller topk can amplify quant rounding when many near-duplicate candidates exist. I traced an example where best candidate had score delta 0.001 -> rounding flips order.
Marta: Quick results in: hybrid+prune16 -> long MRR -0.4%, top1_swap 0.058. int8+prune64 -> long MRR -1.1%, top1_swap 0.072. So hybrid mostly fixes it.
Ibrahim: Conclusion: for models serving >10% long queries, require hybrid quant by default OR enforce larger prune.topk. I'll add a bring-up checklist entry and a CI smoke that runs a pruning sensitivity sweep on length buckets.
Zoey: Filed ticket #2498 and draft PR to gate canaries: "require prune/topk parity and kernel/quant mode matrix in eval artifacts".
Marta: Thanks team. Blocking full rollout until hybrid canary verifies CTR recovery for 1h. Post follow-ups here with PR & job IDs. :thumbsup:
